steps.name: preflight
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "e4a8f31288eb7f000643cecdd6c5351510a89ce6"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; node --version; npm --version

steps.name: baseline-frontend-tests
steps.command: set +e; cd interface; npm ci --ignore-scripts >/tmp/npm-ci.log 2>&1; ci=$?; cat /tmp/npm-ci.log; test $ci -eq 0 || exit $ci; npm run test:run >/tmp/vitest-baseline.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -n 160 /tmp/vitest-baseline.log; echo VITEST_BASELINE_RC=$rc; test $rc -ne 0; grep -q '49 failed' /tmp/vitest-baseline.log; grep -q '48 failed' /tmp/vitest-baseline.log; exit $?

steps.name: baseline-other-gates
steps.command: set +e; cd interface; npm run unused:check; unused=$?; npm run ui:contract; contract=$?; echo UNUSED_RC=$unused CONTRACT_RC=$contract; test $contract -ne 0; exit $unused
